owner: event invite link callables and funnel-attribution triggers
migrationNotes: Named host, direct-recipient, promoter, partner, and attendee-referrer links carry opaque versioned bearer tokens; secret material is never client-readable.

Share intent is a Catch-owned button action, not proof that WhatsApp or another destination received a message. Verified registration and check-in attribution is projected from canonical attendee facts and remains reversible.
Links carry no catch, match or chat counts (FIX-12): a direct-recipient or attendee-referrer link is effectively one person.
